title: Chef John's Waldorf Salad
description: Chef John uses chopped celery root in his version of this classic salad--just 4 ingredients and a creamy dressing is all it takes.
ingredients: 2 large crisp, sweet apples, cut into 1/2-inch cubes
1 cup cubed (1/4 inch) celery root, soaked briefly in cold water, drained well

steps.text: Whisk mayonnaise, creme fraiche, lemon juice, tarragon, sugar, salt, black pepper, and cayenne together in a bowl.

Place apples, celery root, grapes, and walnut pieces in a large bowl. Toss with about 1/2 cup of dressing. Add more dressing until salad components are well coated but not swimming in dressing. You might not need all the dressing.
Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours.

video.description: In this video, Chef John shares his version of Waldorf Salad. He keeps it nice and simple with a mayonnaise-base dressing and just four ingredients in the salad itself. Chef John will show you how to cut up celery root and apples for the salad, and toast walnuts. He adds those three ingredients to cut up green grapes and generously tosses with the dressing.
